ruledBy: Astra editorial review, adopted as Al's ruling (his instruction, 2026-09-05; veto list: none)
note: KEEP and FIX (fixed wording) are kept. KILL is held as `unruled`, NOT rejected — Al ruled that explicitly, so no downstream step may treat a KILL as struck. New-lines CSV rows are kept with source astra-new. astraTime is Astra's own visual reading of the hour and does not override the photograph's rotation slot.

kept.text: Salad for supper has become much easier to sell.
Guests expected. Nobody promised to use the oven.

unruled.text: The day was a scorcher and the stall is selling the antidote by the kilo.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: condition recap describes the watermelon stall.

unruled.text: Watermelon weather: the whole province agreed on it by about ten this morning.
unruled.reason: R1 and R7 fail: weather label invents province-wide agreement.

kept.text: Your child would like the bath moved outside too.
Bedtime soon. Apparently nobody heard that.

unruled.text: The sprinkler went on for the lawn and got hijacked within the minute.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: hijacking joke directly captions the pictured sprinkler play.

kept.text: Shake hands with the steering wheel very cautiously.
Car parked. Now to negotiate with the seat belt.

unruled.text: The car says 38 and the road ahead agrees in shimmer.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: repeats the visible temperature and road shimmer.

unruled.text: That sky is not white, it is just too hot to be blue.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: decorative sky description, no reader consequence.

unruled.text: Every kilometre of that road is being served with a heat shimmer today.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: serving metaphor still describes road shimmer.

kept.text: You paid for those toys. They want the hose.
kept.fixedFrom: On days like this the garden hose outranks every toy in the house.

kept.text: Your children have expensive toys to ignore.
Lunch is ready. Nobody wants the word cooked in it.

unruled.text: The sprinkler is doing lawn duty and lifeguard duty at the same time.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: job metaphor explains the sprinkler's visible use.

unruled.text: Lawn watered, kids cooled, parents left in peace: the heat sorted everything.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: inventories every visible participant and outcome.

kept.text: You can finally sit outside without regretting it.
kept.fixedFrom: First sittable hour since breakfast, and it brought colours.

kept.text: Leave the second shower until after supper.
Finally sitting down. Even that took some planning.

unruled.text: The day finally dropped below thirty and the stoep is collecting the reward.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: temperature recap narrates the stoep scene.

unruled.text: A sky like that is what forty degrees looks like on its way out.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: temperature-and-colour caption, no human consequence.

kept.text: Remember when going for a walk didn't cost anything?
Home soon. Unless someone buys another round.

unruled.text: The soft-serve is losing a race it was never going to win.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: narrates the pictured melting ice cream.

unruled.text: The promenade fills up the minute the temperature becomes friendly again.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: describes the visible promenade crowd.

unruled.text: Still warm enough at sunset that the ice cream is doing the sweating.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: condition recap captions the ice cream.

kept.text: Your evening drink has developed a short deadline.
Bed later. The house still feels rather committed.

unruled.text: The glass is sweating at nine at night, which tells you about today.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: describes condensation and invents a precise time.

unruled.text: The whole promenade came out after dark, when the town becomes walkable again.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: explains the visible promenade walkers.

unruled.text: Night has not cooled anything yet; even the water is perspiring.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: condition recap personifies pictured water.

kept.text: Cuddling will need to be discussed in the morning.
Goodnight kiss. Make it brief.

unruled.text: Too hot for walls tonight: the whole family moved the bedroom outside.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: condition opener narrates the outdoor beds.

unruled.text: The house held the day's heat, so the beds came out to the stars.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: explains the visible sleeping arrangement.

unruled.text: One member of the sleep-out is doing exactly none of the sleeping.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: repetition works, but directly captions the awake child.

kept.text: Your guest can have the chair furthest from the fan.
One more glass. Then another attempt at sleeping.

unruled.text: The curtain is moving, which is the first good news since this morning.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: directly describes the moving curtain.

unruled.text: Ice in the jug, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: object inventory adds an invented temperature.

unruled.text: The first breeze in twelve hours just walked in without knocking.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: personification explains the curtain and invents duration.

kept.text: Your partner has become an unnecessary extra layer.
Pillow turned. Negotiations continue.

unruled.text: Two in the morning and the fan is the hardest worker in the house.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: amusing work comparison captions the clock and fan.

unruled.text: The fan is on its third shift and the night is still not cooling.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: repeated work-shift metaphor describes the fan.

unruled.text: The glass on the nightstand went warm an hour ago; the fan carries on alone.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: invents backstory for the pictured glass and fan.

kept.text: Another swim seems easier than another shower.
Bedtime can wait. Nobody is dressed for it anyway.

unruled.text: Still thirty degrees after dark, so the party moved into the water.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: temperature recap explains the pool party.

unruled.text: Night swimming is not a plan; it is what this weather leaves you.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: justifies the pictured swimming instead of adding consequence.

unruled.text: The day never cooled, so the drinks came to the shallow end.
unruled.reason: R1 and R5 fail: condition recap describes drinks in the pool.

kept.text: Your dog has found a room you suddenly quite like.
Teeth brushed. Staying here seems reasonable.

unruled.text: The lab did a full survey and the bathroom tiles won by two degrees.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: survey joke explains the pictured dog's chosen floor.

unruled.text: Tile is the coldest surface in the house tonight, and it is taken.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: directly describes the occupied bathroom tiles.

unruled.text: The dog knows where the house keeps its last cool square metres.
unruled.reason: R5 fails: explains the dog's visible position.
